guest.bio_context: Hernan Diaz is a Pulitzer Prize-winning author who was published in his late 40s after a long struggle to get his work accepted. His first published novel, In the Distance, was a finalist for the Pulitzer Prize. His novel Trust famously brought together Dua Lipa and her now-husband, who bonded over the book after exchanging pictures of its cover.
